hypothesis.statement: The @0x24c residual is a single MWCC addressing-mode selection: the target materializes the player pointer `base + i*stride` with `add r3,r31,r16` and uses a displacement load `lwz r0,3368(r3)`, while ours emits `addi r0,r16,3368; lwzx r0,r31,r0` for the SAME address. This choice is INDEPENDENT of the source pointer spelling -- p->state (CSE'd), PT(i)->state and PTA(i)->state all yield `addi;lwzx` once they load, so no source pointer expression reaches the `add;lwz(disp)` form. The remaining untried lever is therefore not a spelling but whatever makes MWCC prefer a materialized base pointer over an index+displacement offset here (register-pressure / whether `base + i*stride` is consumed a second time in the block); if nothing in-source moves it, this is a REGISTER_ONLY/addressing-mode residual and a WebFrank-rule candidate now carrying source-exhaustion provenance (PT j-loop probes + this i-loop probe).
